summary: Build skills in discovery, RICE prioritization, roadmapping, and product analytics. Explore the five-day digital product management course.
lede: Digital product management connects user evidence, delivery choices, and measurable outcomes throughout a product lifecycle. For Product Managers, Business Analysts, Digital Transformation Leads, and Innovation Managers, the training offers practical ways to guide a product from discovery through launch and review. You’ll practise research and opportunity mapping, prioritize backlogs and roadmaps with evidence, and plan launches and interpret product analytics to shape post-launch decisions.
audienceIntro: This programme suits professionals who make or support digital product decisions across discovery, delivery, launch, and performance review.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with digital services, business analysis, product delivery, or agile project work is helpful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for spreadsheet-based exercises.
